sections.title: Ticket Purchases
sections.content: All ticket purchases are generally non-refundable unless the event is cancelled by MK Events.

sections.title: Event Cancellation
sections.content: If an event is cancelled by the organizer, eligible participants will receive a refund through the original payment method.

sections.title: Event Postponement
sections.content: Tickets will remain valid for the rescheduled event. Refunds may be provided only if explicitly announced.

sections.title: Duplicate Payments
sections.content: Duplicate or failed payment transactions will be reviewed and any applicable refund will be processed within 7 to 10 business days.

sections.title: Contact
sections.content: For refund-related queries, please contact us at {{supportEmail}}.
